item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Fail to Agree on Peace Deal, Vance Says, Leaving Cease-Fire’s Fate Uncertain
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance said the Iranian delegation had not accepted American terms for ending the war after a marathon session in Pakistan.

item.title: Iran Has Been Consistent in War. Will It Be Consistent in Peace Talks?
item.summary: While President Trump’s war aims have changed by the moment, Iran has stuck to firm demands. The question is whether it will compromise in peace negotiations.

item.title: Iran Tries to Grasp Economic Devastation of War, and Find a Way Past It
item.summary: The vast scale of destruction wrought by U.S. and Israeli bombardment will make sanctions relief all the more vital to Iran’s government as it tries to negotiate a peace agreement.

item.title: In New War With Israel, Hezbollah Defies Notion That It Was Crippled
item.summary: The Iran-backed Lebanese militant group surprised many with the intensity of its attacks on Israel in the current conflict.

item.title: Killing of Masood Masjoody Exposes Deep Rifts in Canada’s Iranian Diaspora
item.summary: An Iranian activist in Vancouver disappeared after accusing two compatriots of wanting him dead. Then his body was found.

item.title: U.S. Moves to Deport Son of Prominent Figure in Iranian Revolution
item.summary: Federal agents arrested a man whose mother served as a spokeswoman for the Islamist embassy captors during the hostage crisis that began in 1979.

item.title: U.K. Puts Chagos Islands Deal on Hold Following Criticism From Trump
item.summary: The plan to give Mauritius formal control of the islands, home to a U.S.-British military base, was called “an act of great stupidity” by President Trump.

item.title: What Now? Vance Leaves Iran Talks Without a Deal.
item.summary: The lack of a breakthrough after 21 hours of negotiations leaves the Trump administration facing several unpalatable options.

item.title: Overlooked No More: Margaret Gipsy Moth, Fearless CNN Camera Operator
item.summary: She covered conflicts across the globe, joking after she was injured in Sarajevo that she would be returning to find her missing teeth.

item.title: Mass Stampede at Haitian Tourist Site Leaves Dozens Dead
item.summary: The tragedy took place at the Citadelle Laferrière, a historic fortress in northern Haiti and one of the country’s defining symbols.
